title: Isolate Cad Play Viewport Cameras
description: CAD play quad windows share camera state: orbiting or zooming in one pane (e.g. concrete asset / structure-classic) causes all other viewports to jump. Root cause is shared modelDefinitionRevision triggering mesh reload + autoFitBehavior changes across panes.
summary: Fixed linked CAD play quad viewports jumping together when orbiting/zooming one pane (e.g. concrete forest asset). Root cause: shared global modelDefinitionRevision forced every pane to clone its document model, retessellate meshes, and re-run SpatialAutoFit with autoFitBehavior=changes. Each pane now keys viewport state off its own viewModel.revision, uses autoFitBehavior=initial, and PlaySession respects the autoFitBehavior prop. Added spatialAutoFitShouldRun regression test.
